original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Exact paid-call minimum for formal F2[AGL_d(F2)] register words, arbitrary d and register count, free scalar XOR basis changes, rank-one scalar idempotents and paid affine address maps with rank([A-I|b])=1. Target is diag([g_1],...,[g_w],1,...,1) on arbitrary dirty inputs. Prove minimum sum rank([A_i-I|b_i]); independently enumerate all affine groups through d=4.
scope_change_reason: The chooser also offered bit-helper-contract, but PR1194 and PR1306 already cover its obvious H2/K and small-feedback variants. Choose the same draw's bit-new-register-model card and replace its abelian rational address group by the explicit nonabelian binary affine group, with unrestricted restored dirty registers. This is a new-model screening bound, not a restriction or claimed improvement of the selected rational supplier.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether noncommuting affine addresses and extra dirty registers alone can beat their direct paid rank-one bill. An exact no-gain result rules out this specified relaxation, while explicitly leaving other alphabets and the rational supplier open.
stop_rule: Prove the sharp target-specific formula with a complete operation bill; test all affine maps through dimension4 and exact group-algebra boundary controls. Do not turn finite natural-representation equality into universal group-ring equality.
evidence: Written all-dimension sharp minimum sum rank([A_i-I|b_i]) for the specified binary-affine group-algebra model, independent of restored dirty-register count. All 323,930 affine maps through dimension 4 have explicit attaining factorizations and matching independent C++ Cayley distances (72,642,074 transitions). Includes 44,020 elementary rank checks, 96 formal words / 576 prefixes, 56 exact formal identities, a nine-call noncommuting target triple, seven boundary controls and five package tests. Registered Python 3.12 and full read-only isolated optimized Python 3.14 replay pass with identical receipts. See PROOF.md and VALIDATION.md; finite checks corroborate the written proof, not a full multiplication theorem.
author: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, verification and writing. No subagents or independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can register mixing help when only coordinate address CNOTs and coordinate translations are paid units?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The present alphabet gives every rank-one affine map one unit. Restricting the physical primitive can make direct single-role lengths exceed the rank lower bound, leaving a different sharing question.
open_questions.first_step: Choose one dimension3 target with coordinate-generator distance above rho, then search an exact formal two-role word below twice that distance.
open_questions.blocked_by: A different complete operation bill and a group-algebra endpoint certificate; equality in the small natural representation alone is insufficient.

open_questions.question: Which physically justified address alphabets avoid this finite-dimensional rank budget?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A nonabelian mechanism must change a material hypothesis to yield a paid saving, rather than just add registers or noncommuting labels.
open_questions.first_step: Specify one new paid primitive/free operation and compare its representation displacement rank with its full charged cost and target boundary.
open_questions.blocked_by: No supplier/compiler/hosting admission is supplied for this abstract binary-affine model, and it cannot be transferred by reducing rational frames modulo two.
